title: Why Your Voice Changes When You Talk To Babies Or Pets
hook: Your voice automatically changes pitch around babies.

narration.text: Your voice automatically changes pitch around babies.
This is a natural response known as 'motherese' or 'parentese'.
It helps babies learn language and emotional cues.
The higher pitch and exaggerated tones capture their attention.
You do this unconsciously, even with pets.
Pets also respond well to these clear, happy sounds.
Try it right now, notice your voice, and tell us if it surprised you, like this if you found it fascinating, and subscribe for more brain hacks.

description: Ever wonder why your voice changes when you talk to a baby or a pet? It's a fascinating, unconscious behaviour with real benefits for communication and bonding. This Short explains the science behind 'parentese' and why we all do it.
topic: Why your voice automatically changes pitch when you are talking to a baby or a pet. Notice this in your next interaction.
